name: spatial-agent-ide
description: A spatial shell for AI-assisted software development

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.demo:capture: npm run build && electron tools/capture-polished-demo.cjs && swift tools/encode-frame-sequence.swift .tmp/polished-demo-frames media/xr-agents-demo.mov 15
